mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees with partly cloudy conditions at Badger Prairie County Park, and we have a Waning Crescent moon in the sky.

The City of Verona has installed a new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture in Century School Park, and there is an ongoing road construction update regarding lane shifts on Highway M for the Aldi development project.
Today you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, while tomorrow features the Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and various trivia nights around town.
The Verona Police Department reported an arrest on Friday, September 4, involving a former school staff member related to an investigation into an incident from 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, and please note the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
